Environment variables override: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL, OPENAI_IMAGE_QUALITY, OPENAI_OUTPUT_FORMAT, OPENAI_IMAGE_SIZE (body only), LUMA_VAULT_OUTDIR, LUMA_RPC; vault_link is the LAN address while he is home, the tailnet one while away.
